title: Left exact functors commute with upper smart truncation
statement: Let B and C be abelian and T:B to C additive and left exact [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. For every integer cochain complex K and integer q, there is a unique complex isomorphism from T(truncLE(K,q)) to truncLE(T(K),q) commuting with their inclusions into T(K). Only kernels, finite limits, and zero objects are used; neither exactness nor preservation of cokernels is assumed.

source.document: Stacks Project, Homological Algebra and Derived Categories
source.place: Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.Embedding.CochainComplex (upper smart truncation), HomologicalComplex.cyclesIsKernel and preservation of kernel forks; Stacks Tag 015X, Remark 13.26.15.

proof.text: Below q use the original complex coordinates; at q use the cycles kernel and preservation of its kernel fork; above q both complexes are zero. The resulting degreewise isomorphisms respect the truncation inclusions.

The truncation inclusion is degreewise monic. Cancel it to deduce the differential equation from naturality of the original inclusion. Assemble the complex isomorphism and cancel the same monic inclusion to prove uniqueness.

theorem leftExact_truncation_iso (K : CochainComplex B ℤ) (q : ℤ) :
    ∃! e : (T.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj (CochainComplex.truncLE K q) ≅
      CochainComplex.truncLE ((T.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) q,
      e.hom ≫ CochainComplex.ιTruncLE _ q =
        (T.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map (K.ιTruncLE q)
